name: KComposer
summary: The message box: one soft rounded box, auto-growing textarea (rows → 8 lines), + menu, the project as a quiet chip, small controls, and the round send that becomes Stop while the work runs.

project.description: A structured value: see the component's TypeScript type.

gate.description: A message box: the send is aria-disabled while empty. A form's send stays pressable so an empty press says what's missing.

line.description: One line: the text and the send share a row.

error.description: A refusal: the words stay in the box.

notes: Focus shows on the box, never the textarea.
On a phone the text is 16px and every control a 44px target; with the keyboard up a docked composer rides above it.

do: A refused send keeps the words in the box with the reason under it.

examples.title: Ask the lead
examples.code: <KComposer id="ask" label="Ask the lead" value={text} onChange={setText} onSend={send} line />
